zero_omission_notes.summary: Derives perimeters and areas of circular sub-regions: sector area (θ/360 * πr^2), arc length (θ/360 * 2πr), and segment area (Sector area - Triangle area).

detailed_sections.full_explanation: Sector: bounded by 2 radii and arc. Area = (θ/360) * πr^2. Arc length = (θ/360) * 2πr. Segment: bounded by chord and arc. Area = Sector area - Triangle area.

practical_lab_activity_or_methodology_ma.aim_or_objective: Find area swept by 14 cm minute hand in 5 minutes.
practical_lab_activity_or_methodology_ma.conclusion_or_principle: Clock hand sweeps sector proportional to time angle.

diagrams_figures_and_maps.drawing_or_reading_instructions: Draw circle showing radii-bound sector and chord-bound segment.
diagrams_figures_and_maps.structural_or_conceptual_explanation: Visual distinction between sector and segment.

master_glossary_units_and_formulas.definition_or_meaning: Area of region bounded by two radii and central angle θ.

short_answer_questions.question: Find area of quadrant of circle with circumference 22 cm.

analytical_reasoning_questions.question: Find area of shaded region bounded by square of side 14 cm and 4 congruent corner quadrants.
analytical_reasoning_questions.answer: Area of square = 14^2 = 196 cm^2. 4 quadrants area = 1 full circle area = π r^2 = (22/7)*7^2 = 154 cm^2. Shaded area = 196 - 154 = 42 cm^2.

comprehensive_long_answers.question: A chord of radius 15 cm subtends 60° at center. Find areas of minor and major segments (π=3.14, √3=1.73).

common_misconceptions_and_pitfalls.common_error_or_misconception: Using circumference formula 2πr when computing sector area.
common_misconceptions_and_pitfalls.correct_fact_or_method: Arc length uses 2πr; Sector area uses πr^2.
